title: Museum of Antioquia

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain at the Carabobo approach immediately across from the axial entrance.

mapIdentity.scope: The eight-point named museum ring places the full block and chamfered corners. The Qualla plan and municipal written description fix organization around the two main courtyard openings.

note: The regional conservation report describes the projected two-material perimeter with an axial tall entrance and stepped terraces. The verified court photographs establish pale wall and pier rhythms and the two visible basin forms. All section heights are estimates.
